description: This file defines extension methods for the EventData class from Azure.Messaging.EventHubs, enabling support for streaming-related features such as setting and getting stream namespace properties, and serializing/deserializing event properties.

classes.name: EventDataExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods to enhance EventData with streaming functionalities.

methods.name: SetStreamNamespaceProperty
methods.description: Sets the stream namespace property on an EventData object.

methods.name: GetStreamNamespaceProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the stream namespace from an EventData object.

methods.name: SerializeProperties
methods.description: Serializes the properties of EventData, excluding the stream namespace property.

methods.name: DeserializeProperties
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array into a dictionary of properties.
